Hi Claudia — thanks for the files. Quick confirmation items so Finance can accept your invoice cleanly: 

1) Please include our PO number exactly as PO-78912 in a single clear field. Preferred placement: add a custom <Parametro> entry under the "Complemento" or include "PO-78912" at the start of the first Concepto.Descripcion. Finance can parse both, but parsing fails when the PO is split across lines.

2) Ensure the RFC is present and matches the Proveedor_Tax_Form PDF.

3) We require both the signed PDF and the stamped XML (CFDI) from your PAC. The CFDI UUID (TimbreFiscalDigital) must be visible.

4) For cross-border services, do you apply VAT/IVA on your side or are you zero-rating/exporting services? If there's local IVA charged, we need a breakdown on the invoice.

Looping in Vanessa (Finance Ops) and Dylan (Tax) to confirm minimal schema and any additional onboarding items. If everything looks good we'll turn on PO acceptance in our procurement system and route the first invoice for payment.

Cheers,
Mateo Alvarez

Hi Orchid / Claudia — this looks good. A few operational items from Finance before we enable PO ingestion: 

- Required file pair: stamped XML (CFDI) + human-readable PDF. Both must be attached to the same submission and reference the same UUID.
- Mandatory fields we will validate automatically: RFC, Timbre UUID (Complemento/TimbreFiscalDigital/@UUID), FechaEmision, Total, and the PO value in either Complemento.Parametro or Concepto.Descripcion.
- For zero-rated exports: please include a short line in the PDF footer stating the export justification (e.g., "Servicio exportado conforme a Art. X - IVA no trasladado"). That helps AP when we tag the invoice for cross-border VAT policy.
- Tax form looks fine. We also need the supplier's bank wiring instructions for MXN/USD payments; please confirm currency and if you prefer a USD wire or an MXN local transfer.

Once we receive the final stamped XML+PDF and bank details, I will enable PO-78912 in our procurement system and notify Treasury for payment scheduling. Expect payment terms Net 30 from invoice receipt.

Thanks — Vanessa Ortiz
Finance Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
